plugins.name: ai-look-up
plugins.description: Detects aimless AI grinding (repeated commands, failure loops, long runs with no output) and injects mid-run self-review nudges via hooks.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 检测 AI 长时间空跑(重复命令、连续失败、只跑不产出),在运行中途注入自我审查提醒,让 AI 及时抬头复盘。含 /lookup-review、/lookup-status、/lookup-config 三个命令。
